subject: HealthSpan security questionnaire: form preference & evidence asks
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Parker <tom.parker@healthspan.ai>, Rebeca Santos <rebeca.santos@healthspan.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: security questionnaire — preferred form & initial evidence asks

Hi Tom / Rebeca,

Thanks again for taking the call today — great to learn more about the HealthSpan ML use case and where inference will fit in your workflow. Per our discussion, next step on my side is to kick off the vendor security questionnaire and get you the right artifacts to satisfy procurement. Before I send anything over, two quick clarifying asks so we take the most efficient path: 

1) Preferred questionnaire format: do you want us to complete the SIG (consensus-based) or the CAIQ, or will procurement push a custom RFI? If SIG or CAIQ would be easiest, we can prefill most answers and drop supporting artifacts.

2) Compliance & scope: can you confirm whether HealthSpan requires HIPAA-specific controls or standard GDPR/SCCs only? On our call you mentioned PHI will be pseudonymized, but I want to capture the exact scope so we surface the right evidence (BAA / encryption at rest, etc.).

3) Timeline & evidence format: what timeline is procurement working to (2 weeks / 1 month)? We typically provide: SOC 2 Type II summary, control narratives, and screenshots or exportable evidence (console audit logs, key management config). Let us know whether PDF bundles are fine or you need structured evidence uploads into a portal.

4) Data residency / isolation ask: any hard requirement for EU/US-only residency or VPC/on-prem? If you need a VPC deployment we can surface the Private offering details; otherwise hosted or dedicated both support encryption and audit logging.

I attached a short RFI template (redwood_rfi_template.xlsx) that shows how we map evidence to questions — once you tell me the preferred questionnaire I’ll prefill and return with the SOC2 summary + an evidence checklist. Proposed next steps: confirm form and timeline, we'll prefill and schedule a 30-minute technical handoff with Marcus to go through any evidence.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0118
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_rfi_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Tom Parker <tom.parker@healthspan.ai>

Cc: Rebeca Santos <rebeca.santos@healthspan.ai>, procurement@healthspan.ai
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: security questionnaire — preferred form & initial evidence asks

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks — that summary is helpful. A couple quick answers from procurement/tech ops: 

- Form: procurement prefers SIG if Redwood can prefill it. CAIQ is acceptable if SIG becomes problematic. We do have a custom RFI but that usually adds time.

- Compliance: we need HIPAA support (PHI flows as discussed) and GDPR for EU users. HIPAA controls and a BAA will be required before any production data.

- Timeline: target is two weeks to complete the questionnaire and review documents — can you make that?

- Evidence: PDFs are fine. Procurement will want a copy of SOC 2 Type II (or summary) and any control evidence you can provide (audit log exports, encryption key management statements, network diagrams).

- Residency: all HealthSpan production data is currently US-only, but we may bring EU datasets later — for now US-residency is fine.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood does shared tenancy in the hosted environment (multi-tenant) or if Dedicated/Private is required for HIPAA? That will affect our procurement path.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — if you can prefill SIG and send the SOC2 summary by Friday that would help.

Best,
Tom
Tom Parker
Head of Procurement | HealthSpan Analytics
Tom.Parker@healthspan.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: security questionnaire — preferred form & initial evidence asks

Hi Tom / Rebeca — adding a few technical clarifications inline and attaching our SOC 2 summary.

> Can you confirm whether Redwood does shared tenancy in the hosted environment (multi-tenant) or if Dedicated/Private is required for HIPAA?

- Short answer: hosted is multi-tenant; we support HIPAA workloads on Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pools with tenant isolation) or Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem). For customers that require a BAA and isolated compute we recommend Dedicated or Private.

> Evidence types

- We typically produce: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), SOC 2 summary slide (attached), control narratives (PDF), and screenshots/exports for configurations (KMS policies, VPC flow logs, audit log exports).

- Evidence naming we find helpful: control-XX-console-screenshot.png, control-XX-kms-policy.json, control-XX-audit-export.csv. If procurement needs structured uploads to a portal we can prepare a zip.

I'll attach redwood_soc2_summary.pdf and a short evidence checklist. Happy to run the 30-minute technical handoff tomorrow morning (I have availability 10-11am PT).

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai

Hi Tom / team — thanks for the quick replies and the timeline. Plan below: 

1) Form & deliverables: We will prefill the SIG Lite (fastest route) and also prepare a CAIQ export if procurement prefers that format. Expect the prefilled SIG + redwood_soc2_summary.pdf + evidence checklist by COB Friday (tomorrow).

2) HIPAA & tenancy: Confirming hosted is multi-tenant; for HIPAA + BAA we recommend Redwood Dedicated or Redwood Private. I'll include the Dedicated offering note in the package and flag any configuration dependencies (KMS/HSM options).

3) Technical handoff: Marcus can do a 30-minute session — proposed slot: Fri Apr 2, 10:30am PT. Please confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite.

4) Next procurement items: I’ll include a standard DPA and a link to our HubSpot deal record so procurement can attach PO/contract documents. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765

If that all looks good I’ll send the SIG prefill and attachments now, and we can iterate with procurement if they have custom questions.

Thanks — appreciate the speed here.
